author: Unreal Engine
description:
Watch this video to discover how Unreal Engine is becoming the preferred tool for kids’ animation, enabling fast iteration, rapid project turnaround, and a wide range of animation styles.

We caught up with the creators of three popular children’s animation series to find out why they chose to build out an animation pipeline with Unreal Engine at its core.

OddBot used the engine to produce ‘Playdate with Winnie the Pooh’, while the YouTube hit ‘Silly Crocodile’ is written, voice-acted, and animated entirely in UE5 by Cory Williams. Meanwhile, ‘BellyFant’, another successful series of animated shorts on YouTube, is produced by a small team using Unreal Engine.

Take a look and discover how real-time workflows have enabled these solo creators and lean teams to punch well above their weight. 

Find out more about animating in Unreal Engine here: unrealengine.com/uses/animation

title: Meet the studios using Unreal Engine to create the new wave of kids’ animation
